blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As it continues to strengthen its water supply system in view of the looming strong El Niño up to next year, Manila Water has completed the 1,200-millimeter (mm) diameter submarine transmission lines for the East Bay Phase 2 project. The milestone enhances Manila Water’s capability to convey additional water across the East Bay area, improving system reliability and operational flexibility to help ensure continuous water service amid the challenges posed by the strong El Niño. The completed submarine transmission system is composed of two segments, the Central and West Bay, which together span approximately 31.5 kilometers underwater and is […]...
